document.title: Small Business Safety and Health Handbook

questions.question: What type of waste cans should hold rags soaked in oil or paint?

facts.text: Covered metal waste cans.

evidence.quote: Covered metal waste cans are used for rags soaked in oil, flammable/combustible liquid, paint, etc .

questions.question: When blowing down is necessary instead of vacuuming and sweeping, what compressed-air pressure limit does the handbook give?

facts.text: 30 psi.

evidence.quote: When it is necessary to blow down in place of vacuuming and sweeping, compressed air pressure is limited to 30 psi

questions.question: Which fire extinguisher classes correspond to ordinary combustibles, energized electrical equipment, combustible metals, and kitchen cooking oils?

facts.text: Class A for ordinary combustibles.

evidence.quote: Class A - Ordinary combustible materials .

facts.text: Class C for energized electrical equipment.

evidence.quote: Class C - Energized-electrical equipment .

facts.text: Class D for combustible metals.

evidence.quote: Class D – Combustible metals .

facts.text: Class K for kitchens cooking with vegetable or animal oils and fats.

evidence.quote: Class K – Kitchens; cooking with vegetable or animal oils and fats .

questions.question: At what source should machinery be locked out, and which control devices should not be used as the lockout location?

facts.text: At the main power source.

evidence.quote: Machinery or equipment is locked out at the main power source

facts.text: Not a push button, selector switch, or other control circuit type device.

evidence.quote: not at a push button, selector switch, or other control circuit type device .

questions.question: What tag wording does the handbook give for structurally defective ladders, and what happens to those ladders until repaired or replaced?

facts.text: Dangerous: Do Not Use, or similar language.

evidence.quote: Ladders with structural or other defects are immediately tagged “Dangerous: Do Not Use” or with similar language

facts.text: Removed from service until repaired or replaced.

evidence.quote: removed from service until repaired or replaced .

questions.question: What minimum standard-stair width does the handbook specify, in inches and centimeters?

facts.text: At least 22 inches (56 centimeters).

evidence.quote: Standard stairs are at least 22 inches (56 centimeters) wide .

questions.question: What does ergonomics mean, and which type of ergonomic controls is most desirable when possible?

facts.text: Fitting the job to the worker.

evidence.quote: Ergonomics—fitting the job to the worker—helps prevent musculoskeletal disorders

facts.text: Engineering controls.

evidence.quote: E ngineering controls are the most desirable when possible .

questions.question: Do I need permission to share the handbook, and is source credit required?

facts.text: No permission needed to share all or part; it is public domain and copyright-free.

evidence.quote: This publication is in the public domain and copyright-free . You can share it, fully or partially, without permission .

facts.text: Source credit is appreciated but not required.

evidence.quote: We appreciate, but do not require, source credit .

questions.question: How many days of paid annual leave must my small business provide under this handbook?
questions.absence_reason: The handbook does not set paid annual leave allowances.

questions.question: Which exact brand and model of fire alarm should I buy according to this handbook?
questions.absence_reason: Fire alarm practices are described without a purchasing brand or model recommendation.

questions.question: What exact dollar fee will my company pay for an OSHA Training Institute Education Center course?
questions.absence_reason: Training resources are referenced, but no exact fee for a company or course is provided.

questions.question: On what exact date will OSHA next inspect Riverside Tools?
questions.absence_reason: No company-specific inspection calendar or Riverside Tools appointment appears.

questions.question: Above what noise level should workplace areas be identified and evaluated according to the Noise Exposure checklist?

facts.text: 85 decibels.

evidence.quote: Areas in the workplace where noise levels exceed 85 decibels have been identified and evaluated .

questions.question: Where should exhaust gases be vented when combustion-type equipment is used in a confined space?

facts.text: Outside the enclosure.

evidence.quote: When combustion-type equipment is used in a confined space, provisions are made to ensure the exhaust gases are vented outside of the enclosure .

questions.question: What minimum separation distance between stored fuel gas and oxygen cylinders is listed when a barrier is not used?

facts.text: At least 20 feet.

evidence.quote: Fuel gas cylinders and oxygen cylinders in storage are separated by a distance of at least 20 feet

questions.question: Who provides and pays for PPE, subject to the regulatory exceptions mentioned in the checklist?

facts.text: The employer provides it at no cost to workers, subject to the stated exceptions.

evidence.quote: PPE is provided by the employer, at no cost to the workers, except as noted

questions.question: If no medical facility is near the workplace, how should first-aid staffing cover each shift?

facts.text: At least one worker on each shift adequately trained and qualified to render first aid.

evidence.quote: If a medical facility is not located near the workplace, at least one worker on each shift is adequately trained and qualified to render first aid .

questions.question: Whose contact information should the emergency action plan include besides key personnel?

facts.text: Local emergency responders, agencies, and contractors.

evidence.quote: The plan contains a list of key personnel with contact information as well as contact information for local emergency responders, agencies, and contractors .

questions.question: Which insurance company does this handbook recommend for buying workers' compensation insurance?
questions.absence_reason: The handbook discusses costs and insurance resources but recommends no named insurer for purchasing a policy.

questions.question: What are the exact daily opening and closing hours of the Kansas City Regional Office?
questions.absence_reason: The contact listing supplies address and phone details, not daily opening and closing hours.
